title: Design System: The Amber Room · Orchard No. 7

headline.purpose: Base secondary headings; contextual overrides are documented.

shadows.name: raised-action
shadows.purpose: Solid lower edge and soft surrounding shadow on primary actions.

shadows.name: dialog-separation
shadows.purpose: Separate modal content from the game.

shadows.name: text-over-artwork
shadows.purpose: Protect lounge introductory copy over artwork.

motion.name: button-transition
motion.purpose: Standard button feedback; removed by CSS prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: reel-acceleration
motion.purpose: Initial acceleration; custom continuous velocity easing in ReelView.

motion.name: reel-cruise
motion.purpose: Base cruise duration, extended by each reel stagger.

motion.name: reel-braking
motion.purpose: Smooth final braking; reels still move with reduced motion enabled.

motion.name: cabinet-glow
motion.purpose: Yoyo glow for big wins and jackpots, suppressed by reduced motion.

motion.name: symbol-pulse
motion.purpose: Subtle alpha pulse; suppressed by reduced motion or zero effect intensity.

narrative.overview:
An understated, comfortable, traditional arcade: a warm lounge, a brass cabinet, and a personal retreat. Illustrated room artwork supplies the atmosphere; familiar controls keep the room and gameplay in the foreground.

Wine-colored cabinet surfaces, Antique Gold trim, and Candlelit Cream type connect the game art to the interface. Mint Light marks focus, active paylines, and feedback. Depth comes from layered artwork and dark panels, with structural shadows on primary buttons and dialogs. Controls are comfortable and traditional: familiar controls within the arcade cabinet.
keyCharacteristics: Illustrated lounge artwork and glossy fruit symbols.
Wine-colored surfaces, brass edges, warm text, and selective mint signals.
Georgia display and numeric type paired with Arial controls.
A fixed landscape stage with calm, skippable win effects.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Preserve Mint Light for the implemented focus, payline, and feedback roles; use Antique Gold for trim, labels, prices, and primary-action gradients.

rules.name: The Structural Shadow Rule
rules.body: Preserve the raised primary-button edge and dialog separation; purchase rows remain flat and divided by fine rules.

dos: Do keep the supplied illustrated lounge, glossy fruit assets, and code-drawn cabinet visually connected.
Do retain the cream-on-dark controls, brass emphasis, and visible mint focus outlines.
Do preserve fixed-stage alignment, clipped reel symbols, and separate lounge and machine views.
Do keep effects calm, proportional, adjustable, and skippable.
donts: Don't present the extracted role names as existing CSS variables; the implementation uses literal values.
Don't claim that scaling is mobile reflow or that reduced motion removes reel movement.
Don't replace fonts, artwork, palette, or control behavior as part of documenting this system.
Don't add card shadows, pressed animations, type-scale ratios, or breakpoints that the code does not define.
